cohort: 206 women with twin deliveries at a tertiary center in Tamil Nadu, India between April 2017 and April 2019.
finding: Out of 206 twin deliveries, 12 (5.8%) were complicated by single intrauterine fetal demise, with various maternal complications observed, including gestational hypertension, diabetes, preeclampsia, placenta previa, and liver dysfunction, and neonatal outcomes including preterm delivery and neonatal death.
